billing-bot: automated alert — invoice 2026-03-ACME-789 generated with a $120k promo credit (trial bulk credit). invoice total = -$48,000. please review for month-end deferral handling.
Anita: flagged — saw negative invoice in AR queue. @Derek can you confirm revenue recognition approach?
Derek: looking. quick Q: is the promo credited against future committed usage or was this a one-time signup credit? need to know performance obligation.
Jon: it's an account-level bulk trial credit we applied during the onboarding campaign — 3 months, applied up front as a negative line on the first invoice. config snippet: ```lines: [{type: "credit", code: "TRIAL_BULK_2026", amount: 120000, period_months: 3}]```
Priya: if it's prepayment for future service, standard deferral over 3 months. but product said this was meant to offset usage during pilot, not prepay. @Tara?
Tara: intended as a promotional offset for Q2 pilot usage only — not a commitment. list of deliverables not tied to this credit. product agrees it's effectively a rebate applied up-front.
Derek: OK — rebate treatment. Per ASC 606, that reduces transaction price and should be allocated to future invoices as a deduction to revenue as the related service is delivered. Because credit is applied up-front, we need a deferral schedule across the remaining service period.
Anita: month-end is tomorrow. can we map this to existing revenue schedules or do we need a one-off deferral?
Derek: create a one-off revenue schedule for ACME: 120000 spread over 3 months starting invoice date. journal to book at month-end: ```DR Revenue Contra - Promo 120,000
CR Deferred Revenue - Promo 120,000``` then monthly amortization: ```DR Deferred Revenue - Promo 40,000
CR Revenue - Subscription 40,000```
Priya: FYI, for accounting close I'll need the customer contract id and the invoice pdf. @Jon can you attach?
Jon: attaching invoice link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/2026-03-ACME-789.pdf — also exported line details to CSV and uploaded to GCS: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-03-acme-trial-credit.csv
Tara: product asked if we should block promo from being treated as prepay in future — want to change UI to mark promo as "rebate" vs "prepay". it's a small product change but helps accounting.
Derek: agree — that flag would let us automate deferral class. For this month though, process as one-off rebate deferral.
Anita: who will create the revenue schedule and JE?
Derek: I'll prepare the JE and revenue schedule. will post the schedule csv here when done. ETA 2 hours.
Priya: I'll review and run the revenue recognized report after the JE is posted. add me on the schedule.
Jon: note — billing export shows incremental usage of tokens after credit applied. can confirm revenue base remains positive for ongoing months.
Tara: tagging growth for awareness — this was from the May pilot. not intended to set precedent for blanket bulk credits. @growth-team
Anita: thanks. please keep replies short here. Derek — once you post JE, I'll sign off and route to close. :thumbsup:
Derek: posted schedule CSV: gs://redwood-finance/deferrals/1923456789-acme-rebate-schedule.csv and journal posted to close pack. JE ref: JE-2026-04-142.
Priya: verified schedule lines and amounts, matching G/L mapping. posting verification note to close checklist.
Anita: closed on our side, will include note in month-end memo about promo rebate treatment and product follow-up for UI flag.
billing-bot: reminder scheduled — month-end checklist item "promo rebates processed" completed by Anita at 1923456901.
